notes.title: VIVR 2.0.0 Updates!
notes.content:
Hello humans! You wanted better calibration tools, we give you better calibration tools!

[b]Changelog[/b]

- Calibration used to be a four step process, and now it's a 3 step process. That's one [b]WHOLE[/b] step less! Magic.

- You can now calibrate in-headset!

- We heard your pleas for native Oculus Rift support, so our engineering team slammed their hands on their keyboards. Result: Native Oculus Rift support!

- Manual tweaking live! Now you can run through the 3-step calibration, and tweak your FOV, Position and Rotation in real-time, so you can get that [b]criiiiiispy calibration[/b] that you've always wanted.

- Comprehensive instructions & imagery have been added! It should be much easier to understand what the heckie is going on now.

And lots of stability fixes and improvements. Even the most elusive ninja bugs should be exterminated. 

That's it team! As always, if you run into any issues just pop into our [url=http://liv.chat]Discord[/url] and ping us. We'll sort it out.

/Love & gratitude from us crazy folks here @LIV
